public_api: SimInspiralChooseTDWaveform(phiRef, fRef, ...); installed docstring exposes parameter names but no anchoring semantics. fRef=0 and fRef=f_lower controls were identical for SEOBNRv4 TD.
conclusion: The documented public contract inspected here does not establish whether phiRef anchors initial orbital phase, reference-frequency phase, or coalescence phase for this TD approximant. Native assembly uses exp(-2 i phiRef), which is an equation-defined m=2 rotation; a self-contained absolute anchor requires an explicit project convention or additional public specification, not residual fitting.
paper: Ossokine et al., SEOBNRv4PHM, arXiv:2004.09442 (multipolar EOB paper; does not specify this TD wrapper anchoring rule).
